english:
And Eliakim entered... to chapter 37:11... "and they destroyed them."
The Apostle: 1 Thessalonians 3:1... "Therefore, brethren..." to verse 11... "may you be perfect."
Alleluia: in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to Luke 13:1... "There were present some..." to verse 9... "you shall cut it down."

Monday. Of the Holy Saints: Bishop Genarius and the soldier Mercurius.
Patristic Hymn [Harts], Tone 3 [gy]: "The warfare" (Zinvorutyunk).
Magnificat [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi], Tone 1 [adz]: "The soldier of Christ" (Zinavorn kristosi).
Midday Liturgy Introit: "Military commander" (Zorakan).
Psalm 131 [132]: "Let Thy priests."
Prophet Isaiah 35:4... "Behold, your God..." to verse 8... "they shall not go astray."
The Apostle: 2 Corinthians 3:18... "But we all..." to chapter 4:6... "of Jesus Christ."
Alleluia: in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to Luke 21:12... "But before..." to verse 19... "your souls."

Tuesday. Of the Holy Saints: James and Iravapar.
Patristic Hymn [Harts] of the Martyrs.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 102 [103]: "Bless the Lord, O my soul."
Proverbs 12:9... "Better is the man..." to verse 17... "is deceitful."
Prophet Jeremiah, Lamentations 3:22... "The mercies of the Lord..." to verse 56... "my voice."
The Apostle: Romans 5:1... "Therefore, being justified..." to verse 5... "was given to us."
Alleluia: of the Martyrs, in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to Luke 12:2... "For there is nothing..." to verse 9... "the angels of God."

Wednesday. Patristic Hymn [Harts] of Penitence.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 85 [86]: "Save Thy servant."
The Apostle: 1 Thessalonians 5:1... "But concerning the times..." to verse 11... "even as you are doing."
Alleluia: in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to Luke 13:10... "And He was teaching..." to verse 17... "were done by Him."

Thursday. Of the Holy Egyptian Fathers: Paul, Pola, Macarius, Evagrius, John the Scribe, John the Dwarf, Nilus, Arsenius, Sisianus, Daniel, Serapion, Macarius, Pimen, and the other holy fathers.
Resurrection Hymn [Ah.], Tone 1 [adz]: "He who surpassed", with its proper canons.
Magnificat [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi], Tone 2 [bz]: "The glory of the Church."
Midday Liturgy Introit: "Hermits of Christ."
Psalm 123 [124]: "If it had not been that the Lord was with us."
Proverbs 21:15... "The joy of the righteous..." to verse 25... "to do anything."
Prophet Isaiah 19:19... "In that day..." to verse 21... "they shall perform."
The Apostle: Hebrews 11:32... "And what more..." to verse 40... "they should be made perfect with us."
Alleluia: "Blessed are they who dwell."
Gospel according to Matthew 10:37... "He who loves father..." to chapter 11:1... "his reward."

Friday. Patristic Hymn [Harts] of Rest.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 97 [98]: "Have seen all."
The Apostle: 1 Thessalonians 5:12... "We beseech you, brethren..." to verse 28... "be with you. Amen."
Alleluia: in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to Luke 14:1... "And it came to pass as He entered..." to verse 11... "shall be exalted."

Saturday. Of Saint Nicholas the Wonderworking Patriarch of Myra.
Resurrection Hymn [Ah.], Tone 1 [ak]: "They who adorned", with its proper canons.
Magnificat [Mankunk] (proper): "The bodiless [angels] were amazed."
Midday Liturgy Introit: "The Patriarchal."
Psalm 131 [132]: "Let Thy priests."
Prophet Ezekiel 3:16... "And the word came..." to verse 19... "you shall save."
The Apostle: 2 Timothy 3:10... "But you have followed..." to verse 15... "in Christ Jesus."
Alleluia: "Let Thy priests."
Gospel according to John 10:11... "I am the shepherd..." to verse 16... "and one shepherd."

Third Sunday of Advent.
Fast-Entrance of the Fast of Saint James, always.
Patristic Hymn [Harts] of the Resurrection.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 64 [65]: "Praise is due to Thee."
Prophet Isaiah 37:14... "And Hezekiah received..." to verse 38... "his son with him."
The Apostle: 2 Thessalonians 1:1... "Paul and Silvanus..." to verse 12... "of Jesus Christ."
Alleluia: in the tone [of the day].
Gospel according to Luke 14:12... "He said also to him who invited him..." to verse 24... "of my banquet."

For the Feast of the Conception of the Holy Virgin Mary by Anna, placed here, which is celebrated on December 9.
In the Evening, perform the Pre-festal service.
Hymn Tone 1 [ak]: "Who foreknew."
After that, Litany: "The Holy Mother of God." Prayer: "Save [us]." Petition: "Receive, Lord."
Then in the morning, Resurrection Hymn [Ah.], Tone 3 [gk]: "Sing..."
